m: 1. घ the 4th consonant of the Sanskṛt alphabet (aspirate of the preceding).

2. घ ind. (used to lay stress on a word) at least, surely, verily, indeed, especially (= Gk. γε), RV.; AV. v, 13, 10 & 11; vi, 1, 3. In the Saṃhitā the final vowel is generally lengthened (घा, cf. Pāṇ. vi, 3, 133)
as a rule it is preceded by other particles (उत, उतो, उत वा, चिद्, न, वा) or by a pronoun or a preposition
it is also found between इव and इद्
or between इव and इद् अह, or between वा and इद्
sometimes it occurs in the clause which depends on a conditional or relative sentence (e.g. आ घा गमद् यदि श्रवत्, ‘he will surely come when he hears’, RV. i, 30, 8), i, 161, 8; viii, 46, 4.
3. घ mfn. (√ हन्) ifc. ‘striking, killing’, cf. जीव-, ताड-, पाणि-, राज-, &c. (cf. also परिघ)
4. घ m. a rattling or gurgling or tinkling sound, L.
a bell, L.

[MBh. iii, 14703], प्रति, -अर्थम् and अर्थे; inf. Pāṇ. iii, 4, 65; Bhaṭṭ.); to reach, come to (loc.), Vet. ii, 9/10; to fall to the share of (loc.), Naiṣ. x, 47; to take effect, answer, Kathās. cxxiv; Rājat. vi, 361; to happen, take place, be possible, suit, BhP.; Hcar.; Śiś. ix, 4; Ratnāv.; Naiṣ.; Sarvad. &c.; to be in connection or united with (instr.), Mālatīm. ii, 8; Daś. viii, 34; Rājat. iv, 617; (for √ घट्ट्) to hurt with words, speak of malignantly, Hariv. ii, 1, 31 : Caus. a: घट् — {vI.v} {c1c} A. (घटते, जघटे, अघटिष्ट, घटितुं, घटित) 1 To be busy with, strive after, exert oneself for, be intently occupied with anything (with inf., loc., or dat.); दयितां त्रातुमलं घटस्व Bk. 10. 40; अंगदेन समं योद्धुमघटिष्ट 15. 77, 12. 26, 16. 23; 20. 24; 22. 31. --2 To happen, take place, be possible; प्राणैस्तपोभिरथवाऽभिमतं मदीयैः कृत्यं घटेत सुहृदो यदि तत्कृतं स्यात् Māl. 1. 9 if it can be effected; कस्यापरस्योडुमयैः प्रसूनैर्वादित्रसृष्टिर्घटते भटस्य N. 22. 22; उभयथापि घटते Ve. 3; प्रसीदोति ब्रूयामिदमसति कोपे न घटते Ratn. 2. 19 is not proper &c. --3 To be united with: Māl. 2. 8. --4 To come to, reach. --Caus. (घटयति) 1 To unite, join, bring together; इत्थं नारीर्घटयितुमलं कामिभिः Śi. 9. 87; अनेन भैनीं घटयिष्यतस्तथा N. 1. 46; क्रुधा संधिं भीमो विघटयति यूयं घटयत Ve. 1. 10; Bk. 11. 11. --2 To bring or place near to, bring in contact with, put on; घटयति घनं कंठाश्लेषे रसान्न पयोधरौ Ratn. 3. 9; घटय जघने कांचीं Gīt. 12. --3 To accomplish, bring about, effect; तटस्थः स्वानर्थान् घटयति च मौनं च भजते Māl. 1. 14; (अभिमतं) आनीय झटिति घटयति Ratn. 1. 7; Bh. 2. 120. --4 To form, fashion, shape, work out, make; एवमभिधाय वैनतेयं… अघटयत् Pt. 1; कांते कथं घटितवानुपतेन चेतः Ś. Til. 3; घटय भुजबंधनं Gīt. 10. --5 To prompt, impel; स्नेहौघो घटयति मां तथापि वक्तु Bk. 10. 73. --6 To rub, touch. --7 To exert oneself for. --8 To move, agitate. {vII.v} {c10c} U. (घाटयति, घाटित) 1 To hurt, injure, kill. --2 To unite, join, bring or collect together. --3 To shine.

m: घट्ट—जीविन् m. ‘living on a landing-place’, a ferryman (commonly Pāṭuni, son of a washerman by a Vaiśya woman; ‘an attendant at a landing-place, taking care of the clothes of the bathers &c.’, W.)
घट्ट—कुटी-प्रभातायित n. ‘acting like the dawn in a hut near a landing-place’, forcing an entrance, Sarvad. xiii, 123.

m: घट्टना f. (? for घटना) going, moving, practice, business, means of living, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 107, Vārtt. 1.
a: घट्टना — [घट्ट्-युञ्] 1 Shaking, moving, stirring round, agitating. --2 Rubbing. --3 A means of livelihood, practice, business, profession.

m: घट्टन n. pushing, touching, rubbing or striking together, Hariv. 14581; Ragh. xi, 71; Kathās. lxxii, 42
stirring round, MārkP. xii, 38
a: घट्टनं — Shaking, moving.

a: घट्टित — a. [घट्ट् कर्मणि क्त] 1 Shaken. --2 Produced.

m: घट्टितृ mfn. (for घटितृ) fut. p. one who is about to exert himself or to take great pains, MBh. v, 5890.
